statement: For the exact labelled 812-vertex cubic graph B encoded by agl_29_g14.g6 in the frozen archive specified by source.md, there is no function u:V(B)->E(B) such that u(v) is incident with v for every vertex and, for every simple cycle C of every length ell in {14,15,16}, #{v in V(C): u(v) is an edge of C} <= 3*ell-33.
contribution: An exact integer weighted-cycle certificate supported on 1,184 graph-validated cycles gives weighted outside-choice demand 16,216,704 but an orientation-independent upper bound 15,153,552, a strict gap of 1,063,152. This resolves only the frozen AGL(1,29) instance that arXiv:2609.04686v1 reported undecided; the bounded current primary-source screen found no equivalent certificate, but no exhaustive priority claim is made.
